kill_risks.risk: Requires consistent filming of tasks which is labor-intensive and may not be adopted by busy stall workers
kill_risks.mitigation: Use phone mounts and auto-recording with voice activation

kill_risks.risk: Expert approval bottleneck could stall entire operations if approver is unavailable
kill_risks.mitigation: Implement tiered approval with junior staff handling routine tasks

kill_risks.risk: SAM-3.1 may not accurately identify all food preparation steps in chaotic stall environments
kill_risks.mitigation: Hybrid approach with AI suggestions + manual corrections

kill_risks.mitigation: Ultra-simple interface with voice commands and visual guides
